steps.name: Build and push immutable commit image
Advance latest only if this SHA is still main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
current_main="$(
  git ls-remote "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git" refs/heads/main |
    awk '{print $1}'
)"
if [[ -z "$current_main" ]]; then
  echo "Unable to resolve current main SHA; refusing to update latest." >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$current_main" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]; then
  echo "Skipping latest: $GITHUB_SHA is stale; current main is $current_main."
  exit 0
fi
docker buildx imagetools create             --tag ghcr.io/lcosmoss/star-sage:latest             ghcr.io/lcosmoss/star-sage:${GITHUB_SHA}

steps.name: Validate registry tables
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
import csv
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.theory_search_states import (
    ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_STATUSES,
    TERMINAL_CANDIDATE_STATUSES,
    TERMINAL_FAILURE_STATUSES,
    TERMINAL_SUCCESS_STATUSES,
    UNRESOLVED_CANDIDATE_STATUSES,
    is_terminal,
    is_unresolved,
)

root = Path("registry")
required = [
    "claim_evidence_v0.2.csv",
    "claim_experiment_crosswalk_v0.2.csv",
    "experiment_registry_v0.2.csv",
    "dataset_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "data_provenance_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "parameter_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "null_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "r&d_artifact_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "theory_search_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "theory_candidate_registry_v0.1.csv",
    "theory_obstruction_registry_v0.1.csv",
]
for name in required:
    assert (root / name).exists(), f"missing registry: {name}"

def rows(name):
    with (root / name).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        reader = csv.reader(f)
        fieldnames = next(reader, [])
        field_count = len(fieldnames)
        records = []
        for line_no, values in enumerate(reader, start=2):
            assert len(values) == field_count, f"CSV field-count mismatch: {name}:{line_no} expected {field_count} fields, got {len(values)}"
            records.append(dict(zip(fieldnames, values)))
        return records

claims = rows("claim_evidence_v0.2.csv")
crosswalk = rows("claim_experiment_crosswalk_v0.2.csv")
experiments = rows("experiment_registry_v0.2.csv")
datasets = rows("dataset_registry_v0.1.csv")
provenance = rows("data_provenance_registry_v0.1.csv")
parameters = rows("parameter_registry_v0.1.csv")
nulls = rows("null_registry_v0.1.csv")
artifacts = rows("r&d_artifact_registry_v0.1.csv")
theory_searches = rows("theory_search_registry_v0.1.csv")
theory_candidates = rows("theory_candidate_registry_v0.1.csv")
theory_obstructions = rows("theory_obstruction_registry_v0.1.csv")

claim_ids = {r["Claim_ID"] for r in claims}
exp_ids = [r["Experiment_ID"] for r in experiments]
dataset_ids = {r["Dataset_ID"] for r in datasets}
provenance_ids = [r["Dataset_ID"] for r in provenance]
provenance_by_id = {r["Dataset_ID"]: r for r in provenance}
parameter_ids = {r["Parameter_Set_ID"] for r in parameters}
null_ids = {r["Null_ID"] for r in nulls}

assert len(exp_ids) == len(set(exp_ids)), "duplicate Experiment_ID"
assert len(claim_ids) == len(claims), "duplicate Claim_ID"
assert len(dataset_ids) == len(datasets), "duplicate Dataset_ID"
assert len(provenance_ids) == len(provenance), "duplicate provenance Dataset_ID"
assert set(provenance_ids) == dataset_ids, "provenance Dataset_IDs must match dataset registry"
assert len(parameter_ids) == len(parameters), "duplicate Parameter_Set_ID"
assert len(null_ids) == len(nulls), "duplicate Null_ID"

crosswalk_pairs = {(r["Claim_ID"], r["Experiment_ID"]) for r in crosswalk}
for r in claims:
    assert r["Claim_ID"] in claim_ids
    assert r["Evidence_Requirement"].strip(), f"empty evidence requirement: {r['Claim_ID']}"

for r in experiments:
    assert r["Mode"] == "controlled", f"non-controlled experiment in controlled registry: {r['Experiment_ID']}"
    for cid in r["Claim_IDs"].split(";"):
        assert cid in claim_ids, f"unknown Claim_ID: {cid}"
        assert (cid, r["Experiment_ID"]) in crosswalk_pairs, f"missing crosswalk: {cid}/{r['Experiment_ID']}"
    assert r["Dataset_ID"] in dataset_ids, f"unknown Dataset_ID: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
    assert r["Dataset_ID"] in provenance_by_id, f"missing provenance record: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
    assert provenance_by_id[r["Dataset_ID"]]["Provenance_Status"] in {"verified", "partially_verified", "unverified", "unknown"}, f"invalid provenance status: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
    assert r["Parameter_Set_ID"] in parameter_ids, f"unknown Parameter_Set_ID: {r['Parameter_Set_ID']}"
    assert r["Null_ID"] in null_ids, f"unknown Null_ID: {r['Null_ID']}"

# Data Provenance Registry v0.1 validation.
provenance_fields = [
    "Provenance_ID",
    "Dataset_ID",
    "Source_Name",
    "Source_URL",
    "Source_Type",
    "Provider",
    "Version_or_Release",
    "Acquisition_Method",
    "Acquisition_Date",
    "Original_Format",
    "Transformation_History",
    "Parent_Dataset_ID",
    "Spatial_Match_Method",
    "Match_Tolerance",
    "Selection_Criteria",
    "Missingness_Policy",
    "Integrity_Check",
    "License_or_Usage",
    "Provenance_Status",
    "Evidence_Status",
    "Notes",
]
assert provenance, "data provenance registry must contain at least one record"
assert list(provenance[0].keys()) == provenance_fields, "unexpected data provenance schema"
assert all(list(r.keys()) == provenance_fields for r in provenance), "inconsistent data provenance schema"

allowed_provenance_status = {"verified", "partially_verified", "unverified", "unknown", "quarantined"}
allowed_evidence_status = {"controlled", "derived", "exploratory", "historical", "unknown", "negative_null"}
allowed_source_types = {
    "survey",
    "catalog",
    "simulation",
    "theory",
    "derived",
    "observational",
    "computational",
    "internal_registry",
    "constraint_set",
    "other",
}

for r in provenance:
    assert r["Provenance_Status"] in allowed_provenance_status, f"invalid provenance status: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
    assert r["Evidence_Status"] in allowed_evidence_status, f"invalid evidence status: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
    assert not r["Source_Type"] or r["Source_Type"] in allowed_source_types, f"invalid source type: {r['Dataset_ID']}"

provenance_record_ids = [r["Provenance_ID"] for r in provenance]
assert len(provenance_record_ids) == len(set(provenance_record_ids)), "duplicate Provenance_ID"
assert all(r["Provenance_ID"].strip() for r in provenance), "empty Provenance_ID"

# Normalize Parent_Dataset_ID values once and retain the previous
# foreign-key validation before traversing lineage.
parent_map = {}
for r in provenance:
    dataset_id = r["Dataset_ID"].strip()
    parent = r["Parent_Dataset_ID"].strip()
    if parent:
        assert parent in dataset_ids, f"unknown Parent_Dataset_ID: {dataset_id}"
        assert parent != dataset_id, f"self-referential Parent_Dataset_ID: {dataset_id}"
        parent_map[dataset_id] = parent

# Reject indirect lineage cycles such as A -> B -> A or
# A -> B -> C -> A.
for dataset_id in parent_map:
    seen = set()
    current = dataset_id
    while current in parent_map:
        if current in seen:
            raise AssertionError(
                f"Parent_Dataset_ID lineage cycle detected starting at {dataset_id}"
            )
        seen.add(current)
        current = parent_map[current]

for r in provenance:
    parent = r["Parent_Dataset_ID"].strip()

    # Derived records may omit a parent when no single registered upstream
    # dataset is known; the unresolved chain must remain explicit in Notes.
    if r["Evidence_Status"] == "derived" and not parent:
        note = r["Notes"].lower()
        assert any(term in note for term in (
            "upstream",
            "generation chain",
            "provenance chain",
            "parent",
        )), f"derived provenance lacks Parent_Dataset_ID or unresolved-chain note: {r['Dataset_ID']}"

    # A record may be marked verified only when source/acquisition evidence
    # required to support that status is actually recorded.
    if r["Provenance_Status"] == "verified":
        required_verified = [
            "Source_Name",
            "Source_URL",
            "Provider",
            "Version_or_Release",
            "Acquisition_Method",
            "Acquisition_Date",
            "Original_Format",
        ]
        assert all(r[field].strip() for field in required_verified), (
            f"verified provenance lacks source/acquisition evidence: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
        )

    # Integrity is intentionally optional until an actual source artifact
    # has been archived or hashed.
    if r["Integrity_Check"].strip():
        assert r["Integrity_Check"].strip().lower() not in {"unknown", "tbd", "placeholder"}

    # Experimental definitions remain in their dedicated registries.
    forbidden_experiment_fields = {
        "Experiment_ID",
        "Claim_ID",
        "Parameter_Set_ID",
        "Null_ID",
        "Primary_Endpoint",
    }
    assert not forbidden_experiment_fields.intersection(r.keys()), (
        f"experimental metadata leaked into provenance schema: {r['Dataset_ID']}"
    )

# Every dataset used by a controlled experiment must have a provenance record.
controlled_dataset_ids = {
    r["Dataset_ID"] for r in experiments if r["Mode"] == "controlled"
}
assert controlled_dataset_ids.issubset(
    {r["Dataset_ID"] for r in provenance}
), "controlled dataset missing provenance record"



# Theory-search preregistration validation.
theory_search_fields = [
    "Search_ID",
    "Claim_ID",
    "Registry_Namespace",
    "Qualified_Search_ID",
    "Name",
    "Protocol_Path",
    "Search_Frame_Version",
    "Status",
    "Candidate_Count",
    "Candidate_IDs",
    "Admission_Criteria_Frozen",
    "Observable_Embargo",
    "List_Immutable_After_Start",
    "Exhaustion_Rule",
    "Terminal_Conclusion",
    "Universal_NoGo_Claim",
    "Controlled_Execution_Eligible",
    "Controlled_Support_Eligible",
    "Physical_Support_Eligible",
    "Notes",
]
theory_candidate_fields = [
    "Candidate_ID",
    "Search_ID",
    "Registry_Namespace",
    "Qualified_Candidate_ID",
    "Name",
    "Parent_Theory_Class",
    "Registered_Representative",
    "Independent_Motivation",
    "Representative_Source_DOI",
    "Admission_Status",
    "Audit_Status",
    "Failure_Gate",
    "Failure_Mechanism",
    "Audit_Record_Path",
    "Terminal",
    "Ellipticity_Selection_Prohibited",
    "Observable_Selection_Prohibited",
    "Within_Class_Model_Shopping_Prohibited",
    "Controlled_Execution_Eligible",
    "Controlled_Support_Eligible",
    "Physical_Support_Eligible",
    "Notes",
]
theory_obstruction_fields = [
    "Obstruction_ID",
    "Claim_ID",
    "Registry_Namespace",
    "Qualified_Obstruction_ID",
    "Name",
    "Protocol_Path",
    "Parent_Theory_Sector",
    "Status",
    "Substage_A",
    "Substage_B",
    "Substage_C",
    "Primary_Question",
    "Permitted_Conclusion",
    "Universal_NoGo_Claim",
    "Controlled_Execution_Eligible",
    "Controlled_Support_Eligible",
    "Physical_Support_Eligible",
    "Notes",
]

assert len(theory_searches) == 1, "P0-SF-v0.1 must be the single v0.1 search frame"
assert list(theory_searches[0].keys()) == theory_search_fields, "unexpected theory search schema"
assert all(list(r.keys()) == theory_candidate_fields for r in theory_candidates), "unexpected theory candidate schema"
assert all(list(r.keys()) == theory_obstruction_fields for r in theory_obstructions), "unexpected theory obstruction schema"

search = theory_searches[0]
expected_candidates = {"P0-T001", "P0-T002", "P0-T003", "P0-T004", "P0-T005"}
candidate_ids = [r["Candidate_ID"] for r in theory_candidates]
assert search["Search_ID"] == "P0-SF-v0.1"
assert search["Claim_ID"] == "CLAIM-ACSC-MECH-001"
assert search["Claim_ID"] in claim_ids
assert search["Registry_Namespace"] == "THEORY-SEARCH-v0.1"
assert search["Qualified_Search_ID"] == "THEORY-SEARCH-v0.1:P0-SF-v0.1"
assert search["Search_Frame_Version"] == "P0-SF-v0.1"
assert search["Status"] in {"preregistered_closed", "active", "exhausted"}
assert int(search["Candidate_Count"]) == 5
assert set(search["Candidate_IDs"].split(";")) == expected_candidates
assert len(candidate_ids) == len(set(candidate_ids)) == 5
assert set(candidate_ids) == expected_candidates
assert search["Admission_Criteria_Frozen"] == "true"
assert search["Observable_Embargo"] == "true"
assert search["List_Immutable_After_Start"] == "true"
assert search["Exhaustion_Rule"] == "N_unresolved=0"
assert search["Universal_NoGo_Claim"] == "false"
assert search["Controlled_Execution_Eligible"] == "false"
assert search["Controlled_Support_Eligible"] == "false"
assert search["Physical_Support_Eligible"] == "false"
assert search["Protocol_Path"] == "preregistrations/P0-ANSATZ-001/protocol.md"
assert (Path(search["Protocol_Path"])).exists(), "missing P0 protocol"

for r in theory_candidates:
    assert r["Search_ID"] == search["Search_ID"]
    assert r["Registry_Namespace"] == "THEORY-SEARCH-v0.1"
    assert r["Qualified_Candidate_ID"] == f"THEORY-SEARCH-v0.1:{r['Candidate_ID']}"
    assert r["Admission_Status"] == "admitted"
    assert r["Audit_Status"] in ALLOWED_CANDIDATE_STATUSES
    expected_terminal = is_terminal(r["Audit_Status"])
    assert (r["Terminal"] == "true") == expected_terminal, (
        f"Terminal flag disagrees with lifecycle state: {r['Candidate_ID']}"
    )
    if r["Audit_Status"] == "REGISTERED_UNTESTED":
        assert not r["Failure_Gate"].strip()
        assert not r["Failure_Mechanism"].strip()
        assert not r["Audit_Record_Path"].strip()
    else:
        assert r["Audit_Record_Path"].strip(), (
            f"audited candidate missing Audit_Record_Path: {r['Candidate_ID']}"
        )
        if r["Audit_Status"] in TERMINAL_FAILURE_STATUSES:
            assert r["Failure_Gate"].strip()
            assert r["Failure_Mechanism"].strip()
        elif r["Audit_Status"] in {
            "PASSES_P0",
            *TERMINAL_SUCCESS_STATUSES,
        }:
            assert not r["Failure_Gate"].strip()
            assert not r["Failure_Mechanism"].strip()
    assert r["Independent_Motivation"].strip()
    assert r["Registered_Representative"].strip()
    assert r["Representative_Source_DOI"].strip()
    assert r["Ellipticity_Selection_Prohibited"] == "true"
    assert r["Observable_Selection_Prohibited"] == "true"
    assert r["Within_Class_Model_Shopping_Prohibited"] == "true"
    assert r["Controlled_Execution_Eligible"] == "false"
    assert r["Controlled_Support_Eligible"] == "false"
    assert r["Physical_Support_Eligible"] == "false"

unresolved_candidates = [
    r for r in theory_candidates if is_unresolved(r["Audit_Status"])
]
assert len(unresolved_candidates) == sum(
    r["Audit_Status"] in UNRESOLVED_CANDIDATE_STATUSES
    for r in theory_candidates
)
if search["Status"] == "exhausted":
    assert not unresolved_candidates, "exhausted theory search has unresolved candidates"

assert "CLAIM-ACSC-MECH-001" in claim_ids
assert len(theory_obstructions) == 1
obstruction = theory_obstructions[0]
assert obstruction["Obstruction_ID"] == "M1-INH-E1"
assert obstruction["Registry_Namespace"] == "THEORY-SEARCH-v0.1"
assert obstruction["Qualified_Obstruction_ID"] == "THEORY-SEARCH-v0.1:M1-INH-E1"
assert obstruction["Claim_ID"] == "CLAIM-ACSC-MECH-002"
assert obstruction["Claim_ID"] in claim_ids
assert obstruction["Status"] == "planned"
assert obstruction["Substage_A"] == "planned"

steps.name: Download Google Docs as plain text
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
capture_dir=provenance_capture
mkdir -p "$capture_dir/raw"
manifest="$capture_dir/google_docs_manifest.csv"
printf 'document_index,document_id,source_url,output_path,sha256,content_type,final_url\n' > "$manifest"
index=0
while IFS= read -r doc_id; do
  [[ -z "$doc_id" ]] && continue
  index=$((index + 1))
  relative_output="raw/doc_$(printf '%03d' "$index")_${doc_id}.txt"
  output="$capture_dir/$relative_output"
  url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/${doc_id}/export?format=txt"
  echo "Downloading Google Doc ${index}: ${doc_id}"
  meta=$(curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --retry 3 \
    --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 60 \
    --write-out '%{content_type}\n%{url_effective}' \
    "$url" --output "$output")
  content_type=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | sed -n '1p')
  final_url=$(printf '%s\n' "$meta" | sed -n '2p')
  if [[ "$content_type" != text/plain* ]]; then
    echo "::error::Doc ${doc_id} did not export as text (type=${content_type})."
    exit 1
  fi
  case "$final_url" in
    https://docs.google.com/*|https://*.googleusercontent.com/*) ;;
    *)
      echo "::error::Doc ${doc_id} redirected to unexpected host: ${final_url}"
      exit 1
      ;;
  esac
  test -s "$output"
  sha256=$(sha256sum "$output" | awk '{print $1}')
  printf '%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s\n' \
    "$index" "$doc_id" \
    "https://docs.google.com/document/d/${doc_id}/edit?usp=sharing" \
    "$relative_output" "$sha256" "$content_type" "$final_url" >> "$manifest"
done <<< "$DOC_IDS"
echo "Captured $index Google Docs."
wc -l "$manifest"
